mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, mn.* from Inv_Rough_Declare mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id where mn.P_Id=#{pId} and mn.Rd_State=7 order by mn.Rd_State_Time desc limit 1
